author: SypherPK
text:
Do All Fortnite Youtubers Think the Same?
Today I brought together @Clix, @NickEh30, @Aid, @Loserfruit, @chicalive, @Zemie and @BushCampDad to get their thoughts on some hot topics in Fortnite and figure out if all Fortnite Youtubers feel the same way! This was a super fun video to film and I hope you guys enjoy!
